title: Lazy Summer / FleetCommander capped-Ark NAV-donation class + BSC DEX router re-probe
closed_reasons: Summer.fi fixed its own Ethereum fleets 2026-07-30 (18 legacy Arks removed, vaults unpaused).
Across all 5 chains the Arks were removed from every fleet except Arbitrum LR-USDC; assets now sit in buffers where donation is break-even.

The only capped AND funded active Ark left is Arbitrum LR-USDC's SiloManagedVault-varlamore ark (cap=0, totalAssets=500.79 USDC) inside a 1,251.17 USDC husk (withdrawable 750.01); the deposit leg is additionally blocked protocol-wide (depositCap==0), so net <= $0.
All other capped active Arks are empty (totalAssets()==0) -> no mispriced asset to inflate.
No third-party EVM FleetCommander deployment/fork exists (GitHub code search); Monad is a zero-address placeholder.
BSC DEX router 0xa331fde0...: the upgraded impl 0xc700cf8d... hardened the V3 callback (transient pool slot + payer bound to the router's caller); 0 standing approvals -> mechanism FIXED, $0 live.
key_facts: FleetCommander.totalAssets() = sum over getActiveArks() of ark.totalAssets(); a raw ERC20.transfer to an Ark is credited with no shares minted (donation-sensitive NAV).

2026-07-06 exploit block 25471348 tx 0x0db528c44f23fc7fa4544684a2fab81096450a14aae8bc89f42cd0592d43da12 (~$6.04M) via a capped-but-active Silo Varlamore Ark on Ethereum LowerRisk USDC 0x98C49e13bf99D7CAd8069faa2A370933EC9EcF17.
FleetCommander is immutable (no EIP-1967 slot, no upgradeTo/proxiableUUID; code 24544 B, identical across ETH/Base/Arb) -> the class can only be closed operationally.

FleetCommander.getConfig().depositCap == 0 on EVERY fleet (verified ETH/Base/Arb LR-USDC + Arb LR-USDT) -> deposits are closed protocol-wide (post-incident cap-to-zero + 2026-07-30 unpause); maxDeposit(attacker)=0, so the deposit leg of the donation attack cannot be assembled.

Live protocol TVL ~= $384k but sits in buffers or fairly-priced non-capped Arks; largest single position is Base LR-USDC 0x98C49e13... ($83,976.83, buffer-only); the Arbitrum TarFi fleet is only $431.52.

Arbitrum LR-USDC 0x4F63cfEa7458221CB3a0EEE2F31F7424Ad34bb58: paused=false, totalAssets 1250799763, totalSupply 1272590566944 (PPS ~$0.000983), withdrawableTotalAssets 750014163; capped Varlamore ark 0x125dAE47930c1118cf2dB5A140877C64B408783C.
SIP2.60.2 (executed 2026-08-12) removed 12 Arbitrum Arks but explicitly did NOT remove the Varlamore ark.
Base Bummer-LR-USDC 0xf762b4E90b21be81E5673058ac01B83A5833A4d9 totalAssets() reverts Aera__VaultPaused -> ~$1.03 bricked (S).

BSC router 0xa331fde028e6F17425AB9333c39ae43722340d24: mechanism FIXED. Impl upgraded 0x241f743e... -> 0x50c08665... -> 0xc700cf8d7adf1782a53a4805d255cf17e126db7f (from BSC block 120724906). New callback 0x23a69e75 TLOADs an EIP-1153 transient pool slot and reverts 'SwapX: Invalid pool' unless msg.sender==pool; the transferFrom payer is the router's own swap-context caller, not caller-supplied data. Live eth_call reverts; fork probe drains 0; Approval(spender=router) census = 0 events over 3,000,000 blocks.
caveats: Point-in-time 2026-10-26; re-read live state before acting.
Census reports Ark-credited value, not realisable value (that divergence is the class itself); the fork test probes realisability.
Institution FleetCommanderWhitelist fleets are deposit-whitelisted but redeem-open; included for completeness.
Alchemy/GoldRush quota exhausted -> keyless public RPCs used; no keyed URLs written.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Lazy Summer FleetCommander capped-Ark NAV-donation class: the precondition (a capped Ark still in getActiveArks) survives on 6 fleets but 5 of those capped Arks are empty, the one funded case (Arbitrum LR-USDC's Varlamore ark, $500.79 in a $1,251.17 husk) is net-negative AND fleet depositCap==0 protocol-wide blocks the deposit leg (fork-verified 4/4 tests); the BSC DEX router re-probe is likewise $0 because the upgraded impl FIXED the callback-auth (0 standing approvals).
